subject.title: [Feature]: Carry gateway client capabilities through the CLI/bundle-MCP backend

question: Should the CLI-backed bundle-MCP backend adopt the same gateway client-capability propagation contract as the inline-widget/client-capability PR once that API lands?
rationale: The issue has a protected `maintainer` label and depends on an open API/security-boundary PR, so automation should not choose the permanent client-capability contract independently.

options.title: Keep As Follow-Up
options.body: Leave this issue open and implement the CLI/bundle-MCP propagation after the base capability-gating API is accepted.

options.title: Fold Into Widget PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 to cover the CLI-backed backend before landing, increasing scope but avoiding a known backend gap.

options.title: Document No Support
options.body: Decide that CLI-backed model backends do not receive web client capabilities and document gated tools as unavailable there.

recommendation.title: Keep As Follow-Up
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and implement the CLI/bundle-MCP propagation after the base capability-gating API is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the issue, the related widget/capability PR, and has the strongest current API/product context for this follow-up.
